fact: The Justice Minister inaugurated an ID-card (BI) production centre in Bolama, the 18th issuance centre nationwide, run under the national civil identification directorate (ANG).

Semlex Guinea-Bissau says it produces and enrols the national identity cards, with centres in Bissau and provincial towns, under a public-private partnership with the Ministry of Justice in place since 2006, while the system is managed by the ministry's Directorate of Identification.
